title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Calculate withholding taxes for vendors (Withholding Tax)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 introduces built-in withholding tax functionality for vendors, eliminating the need for third-party solutions or customizations. The feature automatically calculates and withholds taxes from vendor payments based on configurable rules and posting groups.
key_points: Withholding tax is calculated when posting or paying vendor invoices based on setup configuration
Setup requires enabling withholding tax, configuring revenue types, and assigning business and product posting groups to vendors and items
Calculation rules, minimum invoice amounts, and realization timing control when withholding tax is applied
The feature includes withholding tax entries, settlement processing, and reporting capabilities
features: Round payment amount for withholding tax

quotes.text: Business Central calculates withholding tax when you pay a vendor invoice, or when you post it, based on your setup.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the core automatic calculation mechanism that applies withholding tax at the appropriate transaction point

quotes.text: Withholding Tax feature is currently in preview.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important warning that testing in sandbox before production use is strongly recommended
